clusters.mechanism: Redaction is applied to each output line separately, so a registered credential containing a newline never matches and FailureExcerpts rejoins the full unredacted credential in failures.
Redaction runs after runProcess has truncated output, so a credential split across the truncation boundary loses its prefix and its remaining suffix escapes redaction.
The new verify-prompt tests assert that the credential is absent from a prompt that never renders output or failures, so they pass regardless of redaction.
GATE_ENV_VERSION was not bumped, so cached baseline gate results from before redaction, which hold unredacted text, are still reused.
